candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to owner with assigning admin (different address) so setOwner sets owner = admin instead of provided _owner.
Replace assignment to owner with assigning msg.sender so setOwner sets owner to the caller rather than the provided _owner.
Delete the assignment to owner so setOwner no longer updates owner (owner remains unchanged after call).
Insert an extra assignment that sets owner to address(0), overriding the passed _owner.
Change onlyAdmin's require to compare msg.sender to owner instead of admin, so only owner can call setOwner.
Change setOwner to return the prior owner (previous owner address) and still set owner to _owner; this alters the return value while keeping the call non-reverting.
Change setOwner to return false unconditionally while still updating owner, so the call succeeds but returns a different boolean.

Modify onlyAdmin to always allow calls (no revert) by removing the require and leaving a no-op; this changes whether setOwner can be called by non-admins, altering observable return behavior for some callers.
Remove the onlyAdmin modifier requirement from setOwner so any caller can change owner.
Change the onlyAdmin modifier's requirement to allow anyone (removes admin check) so setOwner calls that rely on onlyAdmin will succeed regardless of caller.
